newsitem.title: USA: Labor Ready Dec same-store sales up 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Labor Ready Dec same-store sales up 22 pct.

text.p: Labor Ready Inc reported December 1996 sales of $19.6 million, up 80 percent from sales of $10.9 million for December 1995.
Same store sales for December 1996 rose 22 percent from the year-ago period. Adjusted for the extra two days in December 1996, same store sales rose 17 percent over same store sales in 1995.
Labor Ready said fiscal year 1996 sales of $163.4 million rose 73 percent from $94.4 million in 1995. Same store fiscal 1996 sales rose 24 percent over same store sales for fiscal 1995.
